ingredients: 2 tablespoons freshly squeezed lemon juice, from one lemon
1 cup mayonnaise, best quality such as Hellmann's or Duke's
¼ teaspoon freshly ground black pepper
steps: In a medium bowl, whisk together the garlic, anchovy paste, lemon juice, Dijon mustard and Worcestershire sauce.
Add the mayonnaise, Parmigiano-Reggiano, salt and pepper and whisk until well combined.
Taste and adjust to your liking.

title: Avocado Toast
notes: Serves 1. Prep 5 minutes, cook 5 minutes. Use certified gluten-free bread to make it gluten free. Scrambled egg works if you don't like runny yolks. Other good toppings: shredded chicken, smoked salmon, sauteed mushrooms, sliced tomatoes, fresh mozzarella, sprouts or microgreens, feta.
ingredients: pinch of salt, pepper & red pepper flakes
steps: Toast your slice of bread. While the bread is in the toaster, mash up 1/4 of an avocado in a bowl with salt, pepper and red pepper flakes to your liking.
Spread the avocado mash on the toast. Top with a slice of bacon and the cooked egg.

title: Scottish Shortbread
notes: Makes 18 pieces. Prep 10 minutes, bake 30 minutes. The better the butter, the better the shortbread. Store in an airtight container in a cool place (not the fridge) for up to several weeks - the flavor and texture improve over time.
ingredients: 1 cup quality unsalted butter, cubed and softened at room temperature
1/2 cup caster sugar, or "baker's sugar" in the U.S. (if you can't find it simply pulse granulated sugar in a blender until very fine - do NOT use powdered sugar)
Optional add-ins: candied ginger, candied citrus peel, nuts, fresh herbs, dried cranberries
steps: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F. Butter an 8x8 or 9x9 inch square baking pan. You can also use a round cake pan and cut the shortbread into triangles.

Place the flour, butter, caster sugar and salt in a food processor and pulse until combined and it looks like coarse breadcrumbs but is soft and pliable and comes together in a dough when you press it between your fingers. If it's too dry and crumbly it needs to be pulsed a bit longer. Stir in any add-ins at this point.
Pour the mixture into the greased baking pan. Use your fingers and hands to firmly press down the mixture.

Prick the shortbread with the tines of a fork, creating rows. You can run a knife between each row of fork tines to make cutting easier after baking. Alternatively prick it right after baking while still warm, so the holes stay more pronounced.
Place the shortbread on the middle rack and bake for 30-35 minutes or until light golden and firm.
Remove from the oven and sprinkle lightly with caster or granulated sugar. Let cool, then cut and serve.

title: Pumpkin Spice Waffles
notes: Serve with warm maple syrup or whipped cream garnished with cinnamon. Freezes well in individual servings.
steps: Preheat oven to 200 degrees F and a waffle iron to medium-high heat. Lightly oil the top and bottom of the waffle iron or coat with nonstick spray.
In a large bowl, combine flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, pumpkin pie spice and salt.

In a large glass measuring cup or another bowl, whisk together buttermilk, pumpkin puree, eggs and butter. Pour the mixture over the dry ingredients and stir using a rubber spatula just until moist but slightly lumpy.
Pour a scant 1/2 cup of the pumpkin mixture into the waffle iron, close gently and cook until golden brown and crisp, about 4-5 minutes; keep warm in the oven.
Serve immediately.

title: Mulled Wine
notes: Serves 6. Prep 5 minutes, cook 30 minutes. Scales easily - increase the batch by as much as your pot will hold. Slow cooker: add everything but the brandy to a 3-quart or larger cooker, cook on low 30 minutes to 1 hour, stir in the brandy, and hold on Keep Warm. Refrigerates up to 3 days; rewarm gently over low heat.
ingredients: 750 ml dry, fruity red wine (1 bottle) - Merlot, Zinfandel, or Cabernet Sauvignon all work well
steps: Add wine, cider, honey, orange zest and orange juice to a Dutch oven or similar large pot and stir to combine.
Add the cloves, cardamom, cinnamon sticks, and star anise.
Bring to a simmer over medium-high heat. Reduce the heat to low and let simmer gently for 30 minutes; do not let the wine boil.
Stir in the brandy. To serve, ladle into mugs and garnish with an orange slice and cinnamon sticks.

title: Royal Icing
notes: Makes about 36 servings; 5 minutes to make. Eggs separate more easily when cold but whip better near room temperature, so separate them in advance. Add the sugar slowly or you lose volume, and make sure the bowl is spotless - any water or fat will keep the whites from fluffing. For cookies, outline with thicker icing first, then flood the middle with icing thinned by a few drops of water at a time. If the icing hardens, stir in a drop or two of water.
steps: In the bowl of a stand mixer or large mixing bowl, beat egg whites on medium-low speed until frothy, about 1 minute.
With the mixer on low speed, slowly add in the confectioners' sugar and vanilla.
Once fully incorporated, increase speed to medium-high and beat until stiff, shiny peaks form.
Divide icing among small bowls and dye with gel food coloring if desired. Keep any icing that isn't being immediately used covered with plastic wrap, as it dries out very quickly.
Transfer to piping bags and decorate cookies.

title: Banana Pudding
notes: Serves 10. Prep 30 minutes plus 2 hours chilling. No-bake. Be sure to use INSTANT pudding mix. Can be assembled up to 24 hours ahead and refrigerated; enjoy within 2 days. For a less sweet pudding use half the sweetened condensed milk or add it to taste. Also works assembled in small cups for single servings.
ingredients: 6.8 oz instant vanilla pudding (two packages, 3.4 oz each)
1 (14 oz) can sweetened condensed milk, or add to taste
steps: In a large bowl, beat the cold milk with vanilla extract and vanilla pudding packets until it thickens. Pour in the condensed milk and beat to combine.
In a separate bowl, beat the heavy whipping cream until stiff peaks form. Add about two-thirds of the whipped cream into the pudding and gently fold in with a spatula.
Add the powdered sugar into the remaining one-third whipped cream and fold with a spatula to combine. Refrigerate until needed.
Add about 1/4 of the vanilla wafers into the bottom of your trifle bowl and about 1/4 of the bananas.
Spread 1/4 of the pudding over the bananas and wafers. Repeat with the remaining layers until you have four layers.
Add the reserved whipped cream over the top of the pudding and decorate as desired. Cover and refrigerate 2 hours before serving.

title: Banana Bread Chocolate Chip Cookies
notes: Makes 16 cookies. Prep 10 minutes, bake 10-12 minutes. No chill time. Use the ripest, brownest banana you have. Don't over mix - stop as soon as the flour disappears. Underbake slightly; they finish setting as they cool. To make them vegan, swap the egg yolk for 1 1/2 teaspoons ground flaxseed mixed with 2 tablespoons cold water, rested 5 minutes.
ingredients: 1 small overripe banana, mashed (it should measure 1/4 cup - if it's more just discard the overflow)
1/2 cup vegetable oil or melted butter
steps: In a large bowl, combine the melted butter, brown sugar, and mashed banana. Mix to combine.
Add the egg yolk and vanilla extract. Mix well.
Add the flour, salt, baking soda, and cinnamon. Stir until combined and no streaks of flour remain.
Last, fold in the chocolate chips. Cover and set aside to let the flour hydrate in the dough while the oven preheats, about 15 minutes.

Line a cookie sheet with parchment paper and preheat the oven to 350°F. Use a 1 ounce cookie scoop or a spoon to scoop out dough balls, placing them about 2 inches apart on the prepared cookie sheet. The dough will be a little wet.
Bake for 10 to 11 minutes or until the edges are set and the cookies have puffed up, but the middles are still underbaked.
Allow to cool before eating.

title: Nacho Cheese
notes: Serves 8. Prep 5 minutes, cook 10 minutes. Do not boil - overheating makes it grainy. Use freshly grated cheese; pre-shredded is coated and won't melt as smoothly. Cornstarch is optional if you don't want it very thick; thin with milk as needed. Slow cooker: set to HIGH with the evaporated milk, cornstarch and all the cheese, stir regularly until melted, then switch to LOW and stir in the seasonings. Keeps 3-4 days refrigerated; reheat with a splash of milk in 15-30 second microwave bursts.
ingredients: 2 tbsp chopped canned jalapeños or chopped green chiles
Chopped fresh cilantro, tomatoes, and jalapeños for garnish
steps: Heat evaporated milk over medium-high heat in a small saucepan. Stir in the cornstarch and whisk to combine.
Once simmering (just before boiling, when it starts bubbling up the sides), immediately reduce heat to low.

Immediately stir in the cheese in batches, starting with the white American cheese. As you stir in the cheese, increase the heat to medium/low and whisk constantly while the cheese melts. Once each batch is melted and creamy, add more.
Once done with the white American cheese, add in the shredded mozzarella. Again whisk constantly while the cheese melts. If you prefer the cheese a bit thicker, add a bit more mozzarella.
Once all the cheese is melted, stir in the jalapeños, chili powder, nutmeg, red pepper flakes, salt and pepper.
Optional: for a browned top, pour the queso into a skillet and broil in the oven for 3-4 minutes, until the cheese begins to bubble and brown.
Top with cilantro, tomatoes, and more jalapeños if desired, and serve with tortilla chips.

title: Krystal's Perfect Marinade for BBQ or Grilled Chicken
notes: Makes 1 3/4 cups, 14 servings. Prep 5 minutes. Enough for up to 4 pounds of chicken pieces.
steps: Whisk brown sugar, vinegar, soy sauce, olive oil, Worcestershire sauce, sesame oil, garlic, and pepper together in a large bowl until sugar has dissolved.
To use: Pierce up to 4 pounds chicken pieces all over with a fork. Place chicken in a bowl with marinade and toss evenly to coat.
Cover with plastic wrap and marinate in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours or overnight, then cook as desired.

title: The BEST Chicken Marinade
notes: Serves 6. Prep 5 minutes, cook 10 minutes, chill 30 minutes. Baking: 400°F for 18-22 minutes (or 450°F for 15-18 minutes), to an internal temp of 165°F. Stovetop: medium-high, 8 to 10 minutes per side. Chicken can get tough if marinated more than 24 hours; marinated chicken freezes up to 6 months.
ingredients: 1/2 cup balsamic vinegar or other vinegar
2 tablespoons Dijon mustard or Spicy Brown mustard
steps: Combine all marinade ingredients in a large mixing bowl and whisk together. Remove a half cup of marinade and reserve for basting the chicken later.

Place chicken in a large resealable bag and pour marinade over the top. Gently massage the chicken breasts and close the bag securely. If you have less time, consider poking holes in the chicken with a fork so the marinade penetrates quickly.
Refrigerate chicken and marinate for at least 30 minutes and up to 24 hours. 4 to 6 hours is ideal.
To grill: Preheat grill to medium high heat and lightly oil the grates.
Remove the chicken from the marinade, letting the excess drip off. Grill chicken for 5 to 6 minutes on each side or until cooked through.
Baste the chicken occasionally with the reserved marinade.
Once the chicken has reached 165°F, remove from the grill and tent with foil. Let rest at least 5 minutes before serving.
Optional: bring the reserved marinade to a boil and simmer until slightly reduced for a sauce to spoon over the chicken.

title: Chick Fil A Sandwich
notes: Makes 2 sandwiches. Prep 10 minutes, cook 22 minutes, brine 30 minutes. To substitute buttermilk, brine in pickle juice only, then combine a beaten egg with 1/2 cup milk and dredge in that before the seasoned flour. Instead of xanthan gum, stir together 1 teaspoon cornstarch and 1 teaspoon water and add to the sauce. Go light on salt since pickle juice is salty. Can be made as nuggets by cutting the breasts into 1-2 inch chunks.
ingredients: 2 boneless, skinless chicken breasts (6-8 oz each)
1 teaspoon cayenne pepper (optional, for a spicy chicken sandwich)
2 slices leaf lettuce (optional, for deluxe sandwich)
4 slices fresh tomatoes (optional, for deluxe sandwich)
steps: Use a sealable bag or a large bowl to brine the chicken. Add the chicken breasts along with the pickle juice and buttermilk. Refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Add the flour, paprika, garlic powder, salt, pepper, and sweetener to a bowl large enough to dredge the chicken. Stir to combine.
Add the beaten egg to a separate bowl large enough to dredge the chicken.
Spray the air fryer basket with cooking oil.
Remove the chicken from the marinade and dredge both breasts in the beaten egg and then the flour. Place the chicken in the air fryer basket. (The egg is optional but helps keep the breading intact.)
Spritz the top of the chicken with peanut oil, spraying from a distance.
Air fry at 400 degrees for 15 minutes.
Open the air fryer and flip the chicken carefully with tongs so you don't lose breading. Spritz this side of the chicken.
Air fry for an additional 5-7 minutes until the chicken is crisp and has reached an internal temperature of at least 165 degrees. Every air fryer cooks differently, so monitor and adjust.
For toasted buns, toast them for 3-4 minutes at 400 degrees.
Remove the chicken from the air fryer and assemble the sandwich.
For the sauce: combine the mayo, honey, BBQ sauce, and mustards in a bowl.
Add the xanthan gum to a separate bowl along with 2 teaspoons of the sauce. Stir to thicken and add it back to the bowl with the sauce.
Stir to thicken.

title: Mongolian Beef
notes: Serves 4. Prep 10 minutes, cook 10 minutes. Use low sodium soy sauce - the sauce reduces and regular soy sauce will make it inedibly salty. Slice the steak 1/4 to 1/2 inch thick. Don't use aerosol nonstick spray in an air fryer; use an oil mister.
steps: Slice the steak into thin strips, cutting against the grain for the most tenderness, and place into a large bowl.
Add the cornstarch to the steak and toss to coat. Let set in the cornstarch for 5 minutes.
Heat the air fryer to 400 degrees.
Add the steak to the air fryer basket and spritz generously with oil.
Air fry for 8-10 minutes, shaking the basket every couple of minutes. Spritz with more oil halfway through cooking.
While the steak is cooking, heat the olive oil in a large deep skillet on the stove. Add the garlic and ginger and cook in the oil for 30 seconds.
Add the soy sauce, water, and brown sugar to the skillet and stir well.
Bring to a boil and cook for 6-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauce has thickened.
Carefully add the cooked beef to the sauce and continue cooking for 1-2 minutes, tossing the beef in the sauce.
Sprinkle chopped green onions over the top before serving.

title: Air Fryer Pork Tenderloin
notes: Serves 4. Prep 5 minutes, cook about 21 minutes. Go with 20 minutes for a smaller tenderloin and 22 for a larger one; the target is 145°F at the center.
steps: Mix all dry ingredients in a bowl.
Trim the pork tenderloin of any excess fat/silver skin. Coat with 1/2 tablespoon olive oil. Rub the spice mixture over the entire tenderloin.
Preheat air fryer to 400°F for 5 minutes. After 5 minutes, carefully place the pork tenderloin into the air fryer and air fry at 400°F for 20-22 minutes. Internal temp should be 145°F.
When the air fryer cycle is complete, carefully remove the tenderloin to a cutting board and let rest for 5 minutes before slicing. Save any juices to serve over the sliced meat.

title: Air Fryer Fried Pickles
notes: Serves 6. Prep 15 minutes, cook 10 minutes. Keep the egg and panko in separate bowls - mixing them ruins the coating. Best served right away while hot and crisp; good with chipotle sauce or chipotle ranch instead of remoulade. In an oven, bake at 425°F and increase the time.
steps: Preheat the air fryer to 370°F.
Use a clean kitchen towel or paper towels to pat the pickles dry. Set aside.
In a small bowl, whisk the egg. In a medium bowl, place the panko.

Dip the pickles into the egg and then into the panko. Place on a plate as you work, then drizzle the pickles with olive oil. Place in a single layer in the air fryer basket with a little space around each pickle - don't overcrowd, and work in batches if necessary. Air fry for 11 to 14 minutes, or until crisp and golden brown. Exact time depends on your air fryer.
Serve immediately with remoulade for dipping.

title: Meatballs
notes: Makes about 24 meatballs. Prep 10 minutes, cook 15 minutes. No breadcrumbs - grated parmesan is the binder. For dairy-free, swap crushed pork rinds for the parmesan. For all-beef (2 lbs), add 1 cup ricotta so they don't dry out. Store in the fridge 3-4 days or freeze up to 3 months.
steps: Add beef, pork, onion, garlic, parsley, eggs and cheese to a large bowl.
Sprinkle the meat mixture with a pinch of salt and pepper.
Mix with your hands until combined.
Form into 1 or 2 inch meatballs - this recipe will make about 25 meatballs.
Lightly spray the air fryer basket with olive oil cooking spray.
Add meatballs to the air fryer basket, making sure they don't touch too much or overcrowd the basket (work in batches if needed).
Cook in the air fryer for 13 minutes at 350 degrees, removing the basket around 8 minutes to quickly rotate the meatballs.
Meatballs should be 165 degrees internally when a thermometer is placed into the thickest part.

title: St Louis Ribs
notes: Serves 5. Prep 10 minutes, cook 30 minutes. Removing the silver skin from the back is a key step, don't skip it. A small air fryer may need batches. Baby back ribs work too but may cook faster. Store in an airtight container in the fridge up to 4 days; reheat at 350°F for 5-10 minutes.
steps: Cut the rack of ribs into pieces small enough to fit on the air fryer rack. Remove the thin layer of silver skin off the bottom of the ribs using a flat butter knife. Mix salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, chili powder, smoked paprika and cayenne together in a small bowl.
Preheat an air fryer to 350°F and rub the seasoning over the ribs on all sides. Place ribs in the air fryer tray.
Air fry at 350°F for 15 minutes. Flip ribs and air fry for another 15 minutes.
Remove from the air fryer and allow the ribs to cool slightly. Baste with the barbecue sauce of your choice and serve.

title: Burgers
notes: Makes 4 hamburgers. Prep 5 minutes, cook 15 minutes. Ground beef should reach 160°F/71°C. Make patties slightly larger than the bun since they shrink, and leave space between them in the basket. Leftovers keep 3 days in the fridge; reheat at 350°F for 3-4 minutes. Easy burger sauce: 1/4 cup mayo, 2 tablespoons ketchup, 1 teaspoon sweet relish, 1 teaspoon apple cider vinegar, 1/2 teaspoon honey, 1/4 teaspoon ground black pepper.
steps: Preheat the air fryer to 370°F/190°C for 5 minutes.
In a bowl, combine ground beef with Worcestershire sauce, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper. Use your hands to combine well, but do not overwork it or the texture will suffer.
Divide the mixture into 4 portions (about half an inch thick), and gently flatten and shape into patties, making an indent in the center of each patty with your thumb or the back of a spoon.
Place the patties in the air fryer and cook for 6 minutes, flip the patties and cook for 3 more minutes. Add cheese in the last minute of cooking if using.
Remove the patties and assemble with your favorite condiments.

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
notes: Makes 24 cookies. Prep 5 minutes, cook 5 minutes. No need to preheat. Let the cookies cool in the basket a minute or two or they will crumble. Use regular creamy peanut butter, not natural. Air fryers vary, so watch the first batch. Store in an airtight container up to 4 days; leftover dough keeps 3 days in the fridge.
steps: Mix the peanut butter, egg, and sugar in a medium sized mixing bowl until creamy - do not over mix.
Add a piece of parchment paper to the bottom of the air fryer basket.
Use a 1 inch cookie scoop and scoop the cookie dough onto the parchment paper. Use a fork and add mash marks.
Place the basket into the air fryer and cook for 8-9 minutes at 320 degrees Fahrenheit until they are lightly golden brown.
Remove the air fryer basket and allow the cookies to cool for a few minutes before removing them to a cooling rack.

title: French Toast Sticks
notes: Makes 1 1/2 dozen sticks. Prep 20 minutes plus freezing, cook 10 minutes. Keep the sticks in a single layer in the basket so they crisp. Challah, brioche, or French bread work in place of Texas toast. Cooked sticks keep 3 days in the fridge.
steps: Cut each piece of bread into thirds; place in an ungreased 13x9-in. dish.
In a large bowl, whisk eggs, milk, sugar, vanilla and cinnamon. Pour over the bread; soak for 2 minutes, turning once.
If desired, coat the bread with cornflake crumbs on all sides.
Place in a greased 15x10x1-in. baking pan. Freeze until firm, about 45 minutes.
Transfer to an airtight freezer container and store in the freezer.
To use frozen French toast sticks: preheat air fryer to 350°. Place the desired number on a greased tray in the air-fryer basket.
Cook for 3 minutes. Turn; cook until golden brown, 2-3 minutes longer.
Sprinkle with confectioners' sugar if desired. Serve with syrup.

title: Classic DIG
notes: Charred chicken, roasted sweet potatoes, charred broccoli with lemon, brown rice, with garlic aioli on the side.
